subject: Urgent: Post-incident follow-up & deployment path (Hosted -> Dedicated/Private evaluation)
messages:
From: Jason Wu <jason.wu@pritech.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: PriTech AI Ops <ops@pritech.ai>
Date: 2026-04-18 09:12 PDT
Subject: Production timeout spike during nightly batch — need immediate guidance

Sean —

We had a pretty severe incident overnight: a spike in generation latency that caused our nightly ingestion pipeline to fail for a subset of customers (batch jobs timed out after retrying). Our engineering team traced it to rate-limiting/fallback behavior from the hosted endpoint — the hosted instance returned 429s and long tail latencies. We have a handful of customers on SLAs and this is causing churn risk.

Quick context: the workload is large batched embeddings + prompt-based enrichment (avg request size ~1.1k tokens, peaks ~8k token contexts for some documents). We were using Redwood's hosted API (single region, default plan).

What we need immediately: clear options on whether moving to Dedicated capacity or a Private deployment (VPC) is necessary to prevent recurrence, high-level timeline for a migration or reserved capacity setup, and any short-term mitigation we can apply (e.g., token limits, batching changes, fallback model knobs).

I can hop on a call — Ops and CTO are standing by.

—Jason
PriTech AI

Attachment: prio-incident-log-0418.txt (excerpted error traces)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Jason Wu <jason.wu@pritech.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-18 10:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Production timeout spike during nightly batch — need immediate guidance

Jason — thanks for the detail and for the log. I’m sorry for the disruption. Quick recap and immediate next steps from our side: 

1) Short-term mitigations (can do in hours):
- Apply token/sequence caps on the heaviest batch pipelines (reduce peaks from 8k -> 4k)
- Add a retry/backoff profile and reduce client-side concurrency for the next 24–48h
- Enable prefix/KV caching for repeated context where applicable (ops can turn this on quickly)

2) Mid-term fix (1–2 business days):
- Evaluate your current model config with our infra team to determine batching behavior and whether current hosted tenancy is hitting noisy-neighbor limits.

3) Strategic path (decision point):
- Option A: Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) — predictable throughput, auto-scaling policy you control. Best if you need sustained high throughput w/ predictable SLOs.
- Option B: Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) — if you need network isolation, customer-managed KMS, and strict compliance (we can run a private control plane).

I’ve looped in Marissa (sales lead) for pricing and MPA details and Dev from infra to scope the technical assessment. Can we schedule a 30-minute triage at 11:00 PT today to align on immediate mitigations and what telemetry we need?

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Exec — Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jason Wu <jason.wu@pritech.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-18 11:15 PDT
Subject: Re: Production timeout spike during nightly batch — need immediate guidance

Jason — appreciate the call earlier. Follow-up on commercial/ops items we discussed: 

- Initial Dedicated quote: attached (proposed-mpa-dedicated-quote.pdf). This is a short-term reserved config: 2x A100-equivalent slots with burst capacity and 99.9% network SLO. Monthly commit with 30-day cancellation during trial.
- Private option: we can put together an implementation plan but expect a longer timeline (4–8 weeks) for private control plane + networking + KMS.
- Security/compliance: Monica will send the SOC2 and network checklist. For VPC we typically need customer firewall/IP allowlist, peering details, and KMS integration window.

Action items from Redwood: 
- Marissa: finalize commercial quote and terms (EOD 4/19).
- Dev: run quick tenancy/telemetry check and confirm whether noisy neighbors contributed (ETA 4/18 EOD).
- Monica: share SOC2 + network checklist (today).
- Jason/PriTech: share the peak job IDs and sample payloads for us to reproduce the workload (Jason to send after internal review).

If you prefer a formal pilot (Dedicated trial) we can provision within 24 hours once the order is approved — given the SLA customers you mentioned, that may be the safest path.

—Marissa
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-18 18:20 PDT
Subject: Internal: telemetry review & recommended immediate config changes for PriTech

Team — quick notes from the infra readout (reproduced summary):
- Root cause: concurrent high-token batch jobs plus default burst throttling on the shared hosted pool created a tail-latency amplification. We saw several requests queue >2s and some >10s, which pushed client retries into Poisson cascades and eventually 429s.
- Short-term changes applied (live): lowered default concurrency for that tenant, enabled prefix KV caching for the batch pipeline, and set a soft token limit for the heaviest routes. Latency improved in our dev replay but real traffic still needs observation.

Recommendation + timeline: 
- Immediate: keep applied mitigations and monitor for 48h.
- If tail-latency persists: provision a Dedicated trial (2x slots) — we can spin that up within 24 hours, attach existing tenant config, and migrate traffic gradually.
- If PriTech requires network isolation or KMS (they mentioned regulated customers): start Private deployment scoping (4–8 week project; includes VPC peering, KMS onboarding, and audit evidence transfer).

Notes for Marissa: hold the Dedicated quote as option-to-execute. For Private, we will need a signed SOW and access window from the customer's network/security.

—Dev
Senior Infra Eng — Redwood Inference

From: Jason Wu <jason.wu@pritech.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: PriTech AI Ops <ops@pritech.ai>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@pritech.ai>
Date: 2026-04-20 16:45 PDT
Subject: Re: Production timeout spike during nightly batch — need immediate guidance

Thanks — updates: Ops confirmed the mitigation dropped errors back to baseline for the last two nightly runs. That said, CTO is uncomfortable with continued risk on hosted shared tenancy. They asked for: 

1) A Dedicated trial starting ASAP (we want to run a 7-day production pilot with real traffic).
2) A clear checklist of what Private would require and a ballpark timeline/cost if we decide to go that route after the pilot.

We accept the Dedicated trial option. Please send the trial provisioning steps, a device-to-device cutover plan (minimal downtime), and the MPA/quote so we can expedite approvals. Also send SOC2/network docs requested earlier.

Next steps we expect from Redwood: 
- Sales: finalized trial quote + MPA (Marissa)
- Infra: provisioning instructions & cutover checklist (Dev)
- Security: SOC2 + network checklist (Monica)

—Jason
PriTech AI
